title: The Daily Five
dek: Five quick questions from this week's verified Israel Sports Pulse coverage — gymnastics, hoops and football.

questions.question: At the 2009 World Artistic Gymnastics Championships in London, which Israeli gymnast won bronze in the men's floor exercise?
questions.explanation: Shatilov's bronze at The O2 Arena on 17 October 2009 was Israel's first-ever medal at a World Artistic Gymnastics Championships.

questions.question: How many EuroLeague/European Champions Cup titles did basketball legend Miki Berkovich win with Maccabi Tel Aviv?
questions.explanation: Berkovich won the European Champions Cup with Maccabi Tel Aviv in 1977 and again in 1981.

questions.question: Who did Beitar Jerusalem host in their 2026/27 Israeli Premier League season opener as Almog Cohen took charge as head coach?
questions.explanation: Beitar opened the season at home to Maccabi Netanya at Bloomfield Stadium, with Cohen replacing Barak Itzhaki as coach.

questions.question: How much was Hapoel Tel Aviv fined in total by UEFA for fan pyrotechnics and stadium damage in the Conference League play-off first leg against Atalanta?
questions.explanation: UEFA combined a €35,000 pyrotechnics fine with €8,000 for stadium damage, totalling €43,000.

questions.question: What squad number was Nico González given after joining Newcastle United from Manchester City?
questions.explanation: González signed a long-term contract with Newcastle and was handed the number six shirt as the club's seventh summer signing.
